title: Make evaluator in-flight retry span cover an admitted authority transition
outcome: An evaluator waiting on a current bounded authority transition can retry within a documented span appropriate to the longer Engram operation window, without changing the recurring scheduler cadence or resending unknown writes under new identities.
acceptance: The host's in-flight retry hint and evaluator bounded retry span account for an admitted authority transition lasting the current operation/disposition window, or the host uses an existing bounded wait owner to settle that transition.

A controlled-clock fixture holds the actual transition past the old roughly9s retry span, then completes it within its valid operation window and shows the same evaluator can obtain its allowed result; another control retains bounded refusal on genuine expiry.
The recurring reclamation interval remains independent, and attempt identity, unknown-outcome replay rules and existing evaluation authority guards remain intact.
